What is the renewable share right now?:
TrafficLight()
| where ts <= now()
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Time_local, RenewableShare_Pct, TrafficLightText
What is the current renewable share and:
TrafficLight()
| where ts <= now()
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Time_local, TrafficLightText, RenewableShare_Pct
What does the renewable share forecast l:
TrafficLight()
| where ts > now() and ts <= now() + 12h
| summarize RenewableShare_Pct = round(avg(RenewableShare_Pct), 1),
            TrafficLightText = take_any(TrafficLightText)
    by Hour_local = bin(Time_local, 1h)
| order by Hour_local asc
What is the current power mix?:
let last_ts = toscalar(PowerMix() | where ts > ago(1d) | summarize max(ts));
PowerMix()
| where ts == last_ts
| project Time_local, Source, GW
| order by GW desc
What was the renewable share per day ove:
PowerMix()
| where ts > ago(7d)
| summarize Renewable_GWh = sumif(GW, IsRenewable) * 0.25, Total_GWh = sum(GW) * 0.25
    by Date_local = startofday(Time_local)
| project Date_local,
          RenewableShareOfGeneration_Pct = round(100.0 * Renewable_GWh / Total_GWh, 1),
          Total_GWh = round(Total_GWh, 1)
| order by Date_local asc
What is the electricity price right now?:
DayAheadPrice()
| where ts <= now()
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Time_local, Price_ct_kWh, Price_EUR_MWh
What is the correlation between the rene:
PriceVsRenewableShare(30d)
| where RenewableBand startswith "6"
| project Correlation, Avg_ct_kWh, QuarterHours, From_local, To_local
Is Germany currently importing or export:
let last_cbpf = toscalar(NetImport() | where ts > ago(2d) | summarize max(ts));
NetImport()
| where ts > ago(2d) and ts <= last_cbpf - 30m and CountriesReported >= 10
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Time_local, NetImport_GW, CountriesReported
How many minutes had a frequency deviati:
GridFrequencyPerMinute()
| where ts > ago(30d)
| summarize MinutesAbove100mHz = countif(MaxDeviation_mHz > 100),
            MinutesAbove50mHz = countif(MaxDeviation_mHz > 50),
            MaxDeviation_mHz = max(MaxDeviation_mHz)
What is the grid frequency right now?:
GridFrequency()
| where ts > ago(15m)
| top 1 by ts desc
| project Time_local = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"), hz, deviation_mhz
How often was the traffic light green in:
TrafficLight()
| where ts > ago(7d) and ts <= now()
| summarize Hours = round(count() * 0.25, 1) by TrafficLightText
| order by Hours desc
